description: This file defines the 'Details' feature within the 'Users' feature area, including a query object, validator, and handler to retrieve user details by username. It handles database access, user mapping, token creation, and error handling.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A request object encapsulating a username for querying user details.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request to retrieve user details from the database, map to a user model, generate a JWT token, and return the user envelope. It throws a RestException if the user is not found.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query asynchronously, retrieves the user from the database, handles errors, maps to a DTO, generates a token, and returns the user envelope.
